newsitem.title: UK: Allianz takes on $90m business from Fireman's fund.
newsitem.headline: Allianz takes on $90m business from Fireman's fund.

text.p: The California subsidiary of German insurance giant Allianz Insurance will take on the renewal of $90 million worth of high excess/layered property and energy business formerly handled by Fireman's Fund Insurance Co, according to ratings agency AM Best.
Allianz said it was part of its plan to become the leading industrial property/casualty carrier in the world.

"Allianz Insurance Co, California, wrote $320 million in property premiums as of the end of 1996. The company expects the renewal of the Fireman's Fund business to lift it above its rank as 9th-largest fire insurance underwriter in the United States, " said AM Best.
Offices will be opened in Chicago and Atlanta to handle the increased business, it added.

Allianz Insurance is also to integrate its workers' compensation division into Novato, California-based Fireman's Fund for underwriting and servicing. The division has about $55 million in workers' compensation business.
